caption:
Till queue do us part, by cohort. CAISO: share of the MW that entered CAISO's queue in the year and had withdrawn by the end of 2025 (cohorts at least six years old), 60.0 percent of the cohort's MW in 2019, down from 83.4 percent of the cohort's MW in 2010. The direction holds in 5 of the 9 complete years after 2010. Till queue do us part, less often.

Checked five ways before it was drafted: the direction holds in 5 of the 9 later years; it survives a change of window; 150 percent of the change remains without the first year; the move is 1.3 typical yearly moves of the series; both ends hold at least 131 observations.

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it.

Source: lbnl_interconnection_queue, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: lbnl_interconnection_queue.
